title: Radon Transforms of Projection Functions and Aleksandrov-Fenchel Inequalities
summary: The Radon transforms on Grassmannians define two families of geometric operators on convex bodies when applied to their projection functions. On the one hand, these are Minkowski's projection body maps and on the other hand these operators coincide on origin-symmetric bodies with the mean section body maps introduced by Goodey and Weil in 1992. Over the past two decades various sharp isoperimetric inequalities for projection bodies were shown to also hold for mean section bodies.
